name: Panda
appearance: A plump black-and-white panda with an extra-round, babyish face and big, sparkly eyes. She wears a rosy-pink, knee-length peplos fastened at the shoulders with simple bronze pins, with a narrow white himation draped lightly around her. The fabric swishes when she takes small, waddling steps, and soft leather sandals peek from beneath the hem. Short, velvety ears, a button nose, rosy cheeks, and a gentle, giggly smile make her irresistibly cuddly. She often carries a small woven crossbody satchel sized for picture cards, finished with a little tassel.
